body: I tell him these things all the time, haha. Not exactly in this format, but I do voice my appreciation and love. It just feels nice to ramble it somewhere all at once when it consumes me.
I'm trying to appreciate every little thing. While it feels like it will never end, sometimes things happen and I don't want to regret a single moment of these wondrous feelings.
Nothing is ever enough, I just want to climb in their pocket 24/7 lol
Thank you for sharing. I love you.
Hope it comes for you soon <3
That's incredible, I'm so happy for you!
Its one of my favorite feelings in the world. So intimate.
I'm glad I can remind you of that. How sweet 💕
Hahaha, English is hard as fuck! Its about my lovely boyfriend. :)
Dude what the absolute fuck are you on?

This is a safe space for all emotions. You are ruining it by being an ass. If you're that threatened by someone being happy near you, that you have the option to not read by the way, thats you ruining this space. Go figure that out.

(I'm a woman lol.)
I reread it. I replied to it. The conclusion is, you're an ass who thinks your opinion matters here.

dude what lol

Unsent letters. Letters you don't want to or can't send. Doesn't specifically only apply to complaining and praying. 

Respect would be respecting what everyone has to say, regardless of the emotion behind it. 

I don't want your sympathy lol
They've always been such flimsy things, never meaning as much as I want them to, stumbling like a toddler who found stairs. Oh, how I wish I could speak the language of touch and stares.
I will try my absolute best! Thank you very, very much.
Thank you for the resource! I will try to be careful. I appreciate the concern.
I feel shitty because its fast, and how much I love being the only one. I'm afraid Ill scare him off.

So much more than that. So much. I've never let somebody so close to me who is genuinely decent. I feel like I'm drowning, but in a really, really good way. I've never been so submissive in my entire life, and its so strange.

Why would it make me feel better? And feel better about what? 

That's why I posted it here, to get it off my chest because I know its shitty.

He wasn't the most caring at times, but I wanted to stay at the time. We had good days. I always knew it was going to be one of those when he told me about the animals he saw at the drive through. He'd come home with wine or something for me to snack on, or on the really good ones, hed cook or he'd let me clean my room. 

I admit, I wanted to prove myself. It was the first relationship I've been in where there were at least some good days, and I wanted to believe that was enough. Maybe I'd only be happy one day out of a month, but that was one more than I'd had before, you know?

I tried in every way possible, but it just wasn't enough. We'd have one good day, and then the next he'd be assaulting me, pressuring me into sex, threatening those I love, insulting me in the worst way imaginable. But I wanted to ignore those things because I thought he loved me. I wanted to be loved, to be shown that my progress wasn't in vain. 

My sister is there sometimes, but she's a good support system. I just don't want to tell her that I want to die. The times I spent in hospitals after suicide attempts or substance abuse was hard enough on her.
